title: Dig
tagline: Brush the dust off a slab and find what was buried.
how_to: Drag to brush the dust away (use Pick for fine edges); sound is optional.
description: A slab of rock hides a procedurally made fossil: an ammonite, trilobite, fern, scallop, lizard or sea urchin. Sweep the brush over the dust and watch the relief emerge, then get a museum tag with a made-up Latin name. Specimens you keep go into a drawer that is saved on your device.
spark: Taken literally: you excavate and catalogue fossils, each slab different.
proud_of: The dust hides a faint ghost of the shape beneath, and the relief is lit from per-pixel height maps so ribs and whorls look carved.
